title: SOLECITO — NextCustomer original score
description: 20-second cumbia-sonidera / East-LA soul fusion for the NextCustomer Short. D Dorian groove that brightens to D major at the payoff. Original synthesized accordion, whistle, brass and percussion; DaemonV12 Living Bass.

tracks.description: Round tuned kick on 1 and 3 (cumbia boom).
Latin tarola backbeat, fills and the build roll.
Conga tumbao: mute, slap, open tones.
Gourd guiro, long-short-short on every beat.
DaemonV12 Living Bass, warm, cumbia tumbao (rack bounce, rate 1).
Bar 1 hook through a narrow 'sonidero radio' band.
Musette accordion: hook in parallel thirds, build climb, payoff.
G-funk whistle lead with slides: B-section call, payoff hook.
Synth brass: the break hit and the sunrise payoff.
Record crackle, crashes, build riser, D-tuned sun impact.
